description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Harmonious Archon, adding {C}{C}.
When Harmonious Archon dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Harmonious Archon from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Harmonious Archon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Human creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Human, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
